integrity: The local equations, intersection-multiplicity calculation, Tjurina Gröbner basis, standard-monomial count, and finite exact replay were reconstructed for this package. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the extremal family \(f_d\) and does not classify singularities of all monomial Cremona maps.
The finite verifier checks \(2\le n\le10\) only; the all-\(n\) statement rests on the symbolic proof.
Originality is supported by targeted source inspection and semantic/text searches, not by an exhaustive theorem over all unpublished or unindexed literature.
title: Milnor–Tjurina profile of the extremal monomial Cremona surface
